UP Deputy CM's Madrassa Remark Sparks Row; Mehbooba Mufti Faces Flag Controversy

Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya stated that madrassa education develops a "terrorist-like mindset." This remark triggered a row, with opposition leaders like Kapil Sibal calling it communal. Separately, Peoples Democratic Party chief Mehbooba Mufti faced controversy for allegedly holding the Indian flag upside down during a Srinagar protest. BJP MP Giriraj Singh called Mufti a "terrorist" in connection with this incident, while Omar Abdullah defended her, suggesting the flag incident was not deliberate. Authorities are reportedly considering legal action regarding the flag incident.
